Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers on MVNOs, eSIM, IoT connectivity, and getting started with Spenza.

What is Spenza and what does its platform do?

Spenza is an MVNO-in-a-box platform: one software suite that lets any brand launch, manage, and scale a connectivity business without owning network infrastructure. It brings together three layers. TelecomHub for multi-operator connectivity sourcing, ControlHub for AI-powered analytics and expense management, and UXHub for branded customer experiences and billing.

What is an MVNO and how does Spenza help me launch one?

An MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator) sells wireless service under its own brand by leasing network capacity from major carriers like AT&T or T-Mobile. Spenza is your MVNE, the enabler that provides the full tech stack: carrier integrations, SIM and eSIM provisioning, billing, subscriber management, and branded portals. This allows you to launch in under 7 days with simple per-line pricing.

What types of businesses can use Spenza to launch an MVNO?

If your product gets better when it is connected, Spenza probably fits. That covers consumer electronics and device brands (think smartwatch makers) bundling connectivity with hardware, IoT companies managing fleets of connected devices, travel eSIM resellers, finance and HR teams offering employee mobile plans, and Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) opening new revenue streams.

How does Spenza manage IoT connectivity at scale?

Spenza handles the full IoT connectivity lifecycle: SIM and eSIM provisioning, real-time usage monitoring, automated alerts, carrier switching with no physical SIM swap, and bulk fleet operations over API. It supports the major cellular technologies (LTE-M, NB-IoT, Cat-1, and LTE) and aggregates every operator in one dashboard.

How does Spenza integrate with existing platforms and applications?

Spenza connects to your existing stack through native integrations, REST APIs, and webhooks, so connectivity fits the tools you already run. Sell through Shopify, sync with your CRM and billing systems, and automate SIM and eSIM provisioning, subscriber management, and usage operations end to end. Detailed developer docs get your team shipping quickly.
